peek_angles.name: Short shoulder peek
peek_angles.description: Shoulder peek A Short from behind the wall to bait sentinel util.

peek_angles.name: Short elbow hold
peek_angles.description: Anchor A Short elbow with crosshair pre-aimed at head-level.

Sova.name: A Site recon from Short
Sova.description: From back of Short, aim high, 1 bounce. Reveals Heaven and default plant.

Viper.name: A Short wall into site
Viper.description: Wall straight from A Short into site to cut Heaven and CT vision.

Killjoy.name: A Short alarm + turret
Killjoy.description: Alarm bot behind Short wall, turret on site covering Short entry.

tips: Short is the easier of the two A entries — use it for fast A hits.

peek_angles.name: CT hold
peek_angles.description: Anchor CT with crosshair on Short entry head-level.

peek_angles.name: Heaven pixel peek
peek_angles.description: Heaven anchor with a pixel-peek over the site.

Sova.name: A Site post-plant shock
Sova.description: From Heaven side, throw arced shock on default plant.

Brimstone.name: A retake triple smoke
Brimstone.description: Smoke Heaven, CT, and Short to isolate site for retake.

Cypher.name: A Site anchor
Cypher.description: Trip in Short hallway, cam behind default plant boxes.

Killjoy.name: A Site nanoswarm default
Killjoy.description: Two nanoswarms on default plant, turret on Heaven watching Short.

tips: Heaven is the strongest post-plant position for A.

peek_angles.name: Long shoulder peek
peek_angles.description: Shoulder peek Long from U-Hall to draw shots from CT.

Sova.name: B Site recon from Long
Sova.description: From U-Hall, aim high at the wall, 2 bounces. Reveals B default and Hookah.

Viper.name: B Long wall
Viper.description: Wall straight down Long from U-Hall to cut CT vision.

Cypher.name: Long trip + cam
Cypher.description: Trip midway down Long, cam covering default plant on B.

tips: Long is the hardest angle to clear as attacker — use smoke + flash.
Teleporter flanks are common on Bind — always watch back.

peek_angles.name: Hookah window peek
peek_angles.description: Peek B site from Hookah window with a wide swing.

Sova.name: Hookah recon
Sova.description: From back of Hookah, aim at window frame, 1 bounce. Reveals CT and B default.

tips: Hookah is the primary B push route — expect sentinel util.

peek_angles.name: CT anchor
peek_angles.description: Hold CT corner with crosshair on Hookah window.

Sova.name: B default post-plant
Sova.description: From Long, line up B site default plant with an arced shock.

Killjoy.name: B ultimate lockdown
Killjoy.description: Lockdown from CT to force retake across the whole B site.

tips: Post-plant from Long is strongest on B.
